topic.title: National myths: the Kalevala, Karelianism and Lalli

queries.text: Kalevala, Karelianism and the Lalli legend as Finnish national myths
Kalevala, karelianismi ja Lallin legenda kansallismyytteinä
Finnish national romanticism and the myths behind national identity
Kalevala, karelianismen och Lallilegenden som finska nationalmyter

items.label: contested
items.description: Puts back a passage saying 'Kalevala culture' is mentioned in the Anglo-Saxon poem Widsith ('Ja Caelic hallitsi finnejä', 'And Caelic ruled the Finns'), with a list of scholars who linked Caelic to Kaleva.
items.why: Level 2. Claim, quoted from the added text: 'Kalevalainen kulttuuri tarkoittaa suomalaisten tai suomensukuisten väestöjen mytologiaa, josta on maininta anglosaksisessa muinaisrunossa WIDSITH, joka on muistiinmerkitty 600 -luvulta' ('Kalevala culture means the mythology of the Finns or Finnic peoples, which is mentioned in the Anglo-Saxon ancient poem WIDSITH, written down in the 600s'): it states a scholarly identification (Caelic = Kaleva) as a mention of 'Kalevala culture'. Community dispute: removed by a different account (E23) after 15 min with the summary 'poisto, Widsithin spekulatiivinen yhteys Kalevaan mainintaan jo' ('removal, Widsith's speculative connection to Kaleva [is] already mentioned'), which calls the connection speculative (accuracy) besides duplicate; and the inserting summary begins 'PALAUTETTU' ('RESTORED'), so this edit itself put the text back after an earlier removal that the pack does not show. Not level 3: one account (E30, named), one article; only one insertion is visible, so persistence cannot be shown. Not kept (removal not undone). Weakest point: the removal summary's main reason is duplication. Candidate c09.

items.label: contested
items.description: Adds to 'Kalevalan synty' that epic poetry is found almost everywhere, has often been compiled into written epics, and that the Kalevala would hardly have come about without the model of earlier epics (cited to SKS).
items.why: Level 2. Claim (content dispute over the Kalevala's origin), quoted from the added text: 'Kalevalakaan tuskin olisi syntynyt ilman edeltäneiden eepposten mallia' ('the Kalevala, too, would hardly have come about without the model of earlier epics'). Community dispute: an edit war over this passage on 2007-01-03 from 10:31 UTC until just after 11:12. E30 removed its opening sentence (2138187, summary 'Väärää tietoa, turhana pois, koska eeppistä runoutta ei ole kirjoitettuna kuin Kreikassa, Suomessa ja Virossa', 'Wrong information, removed as unnecessary, because epic poetry exists in written form only in Greece, Finland and Estonia'); E23 restored it 76 s later (2138193, c29), which 2138201 undid; E23 then added the longer passage (2138403, c12, summary: the worldwide perspective is essential and its absence is one of the article's worst gaps); E30 removed it after 5 min (2138429, summary: the culture behind the Kalevala did not read other countries' epics); E31 put it back (2138438, c17); E30 removed it again 73 s later (2138447), and that removal was undone by 2138450. So: an accuracy summary ('Väärää tietoa'), put back 4 times, a back-and-forth. Inserting revs here are the two pack edits that added the passage (2138193 and 2138450 appear only as removal-undo ids). Not level 3: two inserting accounts (E23, E31) is one signal, but one article, all re-insertions within about 45 min, no source change. Review caveat: not kept by the flag (the 2007 wording is not in the latest revision), but the same passage, reworded, is still in the 2008 version restored in c25 and survives the 2017 rewrite in c30; if the latest revision still has it, 'kept' would apply instead.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds that the coat of arms of Lönnrot's home municipality Sammatti has a maple leaf in the middle ('lönn' is Swedish for maple).
items.why: Level 1. Substantive trivia added by E616, removed 2.5 days later by a different account (E617) in a revert of the whole run, summary 'sotkua pois ja mukana menee myös toisen lähteetön ja kenties tarpeeton lisäys' ('removing the mess; another editor's unsourced and perhaps unnecessary addition goes with it'). Capped at level 1: a plausible statement with no slant whose only recorded problem is a missing source (good-faith error). The other edits in the run (three tiny edits by E615, each undone by E304) are not part of this item; their text is not visible. Not kept (removal not undone). Candidate c02.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds six of Lönnrot's works (e.g. the 1849 Kalevala, Kokeita suomalaisessa laulannassa 1846, the 1880 incantation collection) with Project Gutenberg e-book links, and e-book links to two existing entries, in the works list.
items.why: Level 1. Substantive (titles, years, links) added by E507 (summary 'Lisätty jokunen kirja ja siihen e-kirja-linkki', 'Added a few books and e-book links'), removed 32 h later by a different account (E509) when it reverted the whole run to the previous version with the summary 'sotkemista' ('messing'), which describes the next editor's edits in the same run (item n02). No claim and no dispute about this content, so level 1 only. Candidate c03 (shared with n02).

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds a personal reading of the Marjatta poem: the 'King of Karelia' is the lion of Finland's coat of arms, Väinämöinen stands for Russia in 1943, and a person with the same soul was born in 1956.
items.why: Level 1. Coherent but unencyclopedic interpretation, borderline nonsense, so judged as content rather than graffiti: e.g. 'Väinämöinen kuvaa Venäjää ja tapahtumia toisen maailmansodan aikana 1943' ('Väinämöinen depicts Russia and events during the Second World War in 1943') and 'Samaan psykofyysiseen perimään syntyi 1956 saman sielun omaava henkilö' ('into the same psychophysical heredity a person with the same soul was born in 1956'); it also changed the name Virokannas to Virokangas in the plot summary. Added in four edits by E101 within 21 min, removed by a different account (E102) 56 min after the first edit with the summary 'rv * 4' (no reason). No accuracy/neutrality/sourcing summary, never put back, no dispute template, so not level 2; category other. Candidate c04.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds a 'See also' link to a hotel's web page with the tagline 'Hotelli, jolla on Tarina ja Tyyli' ('a hotel with Story and Style').
items.why: Level 1. A commercial link with a name and a tagline (adds text, so not markup-only), removed 2.7 h later by a different account (E179) with the summary 'rv'. Link spam is category other in the classification scheme: capped at level 1, not excluded as graffiti. No dispute signal. Candidate c10.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Pastes a cruise company's advert, schedule notes and contact details for the paddle steamer 'Elias Lönnrot' into the family section.
items.why: Level 1. Coherent promotional prose (cruises on Keurusselkä, dance cruises in summer 2008, company address), added by E203 (anonymous) and removed 6 min later by a different account (E95) with a plain rollback summary. Advertising is category other: capped at level 1, not graffiti. No dispute signal. Candidate c14 (its removal summary in the pack contains an unmasked username).

items.label: reverted
items.description: Puts the history section back after it had been replaced with 'ERROR', including paragraphs naming the scholars of the western and Karelian origin theories and an unsourced paragraph on oral transmission.
items.why: Level 1. The pack's inserting revision 7992248 (E124, 2010) is a rollback (summary: a user's edits undone, earlier version restored) that re-added the whole history section over a version reading 'ERROR' (insertion_diff); the text itself is older (much of it is already in the 2008 version in c25). E192 cut these paragraphs 7.8 years later while rewriting the section, summary 'vähän lisää lähteestä; tiivistetään ja karsitaan lähteettömyyksiä ja nimilistoja' ('a bit more from the source; condensing and cutting unsourced bits and name lists'); several cut sentences carried {{lähde}} (citation needed) tags. Sourcing reason, but the cut text has no slant (it lists researchers on both origin theories, and the rewrite keeps the conclusion that the Kalevala has both western and eastern material), so it is capped at level 1 as unsourced good-faith text. The epic-tradition paragraph of item i02 was moved, not removed, in this edit. Candidate c30.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Rewrites a lead cut to 'Kalevala on Suomeneepos' back into a full lead: the national epic of Finland and the Republic of Karelia, based on folk poems Lönnrot collected from 1828, Old Kalevala 1835, New Kalevala 1849.
items.why: Level 1, close to an exclusion. The previous revision (17697077) had cut the lead to 'Kalevala on Suomeneepos' ('Kalevala is Finland's-epic', run together); E254 (anonymous) wrote the full lead back; E75 rolled E254 back to that cut version 24 min later, and the rollback was undone by the very next revision (17697125). Not kept: the flag added_text_in_latest_revision is not set, and the current lead in the pack reads differently ('Kalevala on Suomen kansalliseepos, Elias Lönnrotin kokoama ja toimittama runoelma…', without 'ja Karjalan tasavallan'). No claim is pushed and the rollback gave no reason, so level 1, category other. Candidate c08.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Restores the Lalli article's hatnote, image and lead paragraph after an anonymous editor had removed them.
items.why: Excluded: kept. The 'insertion' is E212's revert (16054174) of E682's removal of the hatnote, image and lead ('Fixed more', -1,217 bytes). E683, in the same masked range as E682 (188.238.x.x), removed them again 43.7 h later (summary 'Kirjotus', 'writing'); that removal was undone by 16057398. The restored lead sentence 'Lalli (mahdollisesti Laurentius, Lauri tai Lalloi) on otaksuttavasti 1100-luvulla elänyt köyliöläinen talonpoika, joka kansanperinteen mukaan surmasi piispa Henrikin Köyliönjärven jäällä 20. tammikuuta noin vuonna 1156' is word for word the current lead in the pack's article snapshot. Note: the flag added_text_in_latest_revision is not set (the template, image or citation lines presumably differ), so a strict reading of the flag would give level 1 instead. Candidate c01.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Renames headings to 'Lönruudin pärinät' and 'pärinä vuodet', replaces the end of a paragraph on epidemics with emojis, breaks an image link and changes a citation year.
items.why: Excluded: graffiti. Four edits by E508 (anonymous) within 5 min: mocking headings ('Lönruudin pärinät', roughly 'Lönnrot's rattlings'), a passage on typhus and smallpox replaced with '😂😂😂…🐳', a broken image link, and a 0-byte edit in the sources section (the diff shows the Schybergson citation year changed 1998 to 2015). Reverted 1 min after the last edit with the summary 'sotkemista' ('messing'). Candidate c03 (the earlier edit in the same run is item i04).

Added by E681 (anonymous), reverted by E197 110 s later. Candidate c16.

topic.notes: Labeller (claude): the only disputes in the pack are on Kalevala in 2007: an edit war in 'Kalevalan synty' over whether the Kalevala drew on foreign epics (i02) and a re-inserted Widsith / 'Kalevala culture' passage by an editor on the removing side of that war (i01). The rest is graffiti, spam, markup or collateral removals. Karelianismi has no substantive removals (only a template, n15); Lalli's candidates are graffiti or a restored lead. No campaign: every dispute is one article and same-day. Skipped c18 (added text not visible) and c31 (text-search inserting revision does not add the cut paragraphs). Three summaries in the pack (c14, c17, c30) contain unmasked usernames.

skipped.reason: The diff is truncated after about 9,000 characters that show only removed lines (templates, infobox, lead, family section); the text E604 added (+136 bytes net, summary 'elias lönrött tietoja netistä', 'elias lönnrot info from the net', undone after 28 s) is not visible, so neither content nor graffiti can be judged.

Inserting revision found by text search (16067366, E702) does not add the removed text: the paragraphs it added (Jari Tammi novel, first Kalevala film project) were only moved and copy-edited by E73's edit (they reappear as '+' lines), while the three paragraphs E73 actually cut ('Kalevalan kuvat ovat piirustuksia…', 'Kalevalan visualisointi…', 'Suomen kansanrunoutta alettiin kuvittaa…', each tagged {{lähde}}) are not among 16067366's visible added lines and sat under the 'Kalevalan kuvat' heading that 16067366 removed, so they look older. No revision in the pack added them.
